soldier: Soldier head deep yellow, mandibles deep reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.52–0.57, the sides almost parallel and slightly constricted at the middle, the posterior margin broadly straight. The frontal ridge is slightly raised and clearly divided into two ridges with a V-shaped depression in the middle. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent apical region projecting as a triangle, needle-like at the tip but rather short and stout, bearing apical hairs with the subapical hairs faintly discernible. The mandibles are robust and powerful, their apices strongly curved, the ridge-like process at the mandibular base distinct; the mandibular length about 0.55 times the head capsule length and about 0.98–0.99 times the head width. Antennae with 17–18 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, its anterolateral margins nearly trapezoidally expanding behind and slightly concave at the middle, the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.33–0.34. The pronotum is nearly kidney-shaped, about 1.7 times as wide as long, the anterior margin straight with a V-shaped notch in the middle, the sides together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc, the median notch of the posterior margin rather shallow, with about six to ten hairs in the middle region.
